subject: Priv deploy addendum: escrow timing, evidence & legal sprint
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@valleyhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@valleyhealth.com
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment: addendum timing + evidence dependencies

Connor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and Audit are aligned that ValleyHealth will move forward with a private VPC deployment if we can get three items clarified up front: 1) the licensed runtime / operator rights in the MSA addendum (we need specific language for operator access and restart privileges), 2) the evidence/snapshot cadence your team can commit to for the first 12 months, and 3) a clear escrow-like pathway (what artifacts, who holds them, access triggers).

Attached is a short list of questions from our security team (Valley_MSA_questions). High level ask: can Redwood provide a draft redline to the addendum and an ETA for legal review so we can slot this into our procurement calendar (targeting signing the order form by end of month).

We also need to coordinate with the external auditor (cc'd audit-team) on what artifacts they will need for the ROI / onsite witness window.

Can you confirm who on your legal/ops side will own the redline and an expected turnaround?

Appreciate it —
Alice

--
Alice Nguyen
Sr. Manager, Procurement | ValleyHealth
a: alice.nguyen@valleyhealth.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@valleyhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: addendum timing + evidence dependencies

Alice — thanks for the clear list and the attached PDF. I've looped in Karthik (inference/legal lead), Marissa (contracts) and David (ops lead) so we can align legal redlines with the operational evidence plan. Quick plan below: 

- We will produce a first-pass redline to the private deployment addendum by Fri 2027-09-03 EOD (target). That will cover: licensed runtime scope, operator restart/access boundaries, audit triggers, and a proposed evidence cadence for the first 12 months.
- Ops will draft an "evidence matrix" that maps artifacts (snapshots, logs, witness access) to custody/transfer conditions and retention periods. Expect that as CSV by Mon 2027-09-06.
- We propose an escrow-like path where Redwood deposits an encrypted snapshot + signed manifest with a neutral escrow steward (options: legal escrow firm or a mutually approved cloud key vault steward). We'll include two alternatives in the redline: (A) limited escrow (snapshot + manifest, release on legal trigger) and (B) witness-lite (onsite witness + ephemeral console access window).

Two asks from ValleyHealth team to keep things moving: 1) which alternative you prefer (A or B) or if you need both evaluated, and 2) any mandatory SLA carveouts that procurement insists on for the first 6 months.

I'll attach an internal workplan and the Valley questions to the redline packet. If you need a short sync, we have a 30-min slot Thu 09/02 10:00–10:30 PT open.

Thanks — I'll follow up with the redline and evidence matrix.

--
Connor O'Brien
Strategic Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment: addendum timing + evidence dependencies

Marissa / David — forwarding ValleyHealth's request and Connor's outline. I reviewed the attached questions and drafted a first-pass redline (RH-privdeploy-addendum_redline_v1.docx) focused on three areas: license scope, operator rights, and escrow triggers. Key items I want legal to consider before we send externally: 

1) License scope: proposed language narrows operator privileges to "operator actions strictly necessary for runtime health and security" with an enumeration (restart, scale, patch apply). We should avoid broad "maintenance" language that could be read as access to customer data sets.

2) Operator access gating: require written approval from a named customer security contact + time-limited access tokens; include audit log export obligations (48h retention for event logs, 12 months for witness artifacts).

3) Escrow-like pathway: two-tier option as Connor suggested. For Option A (snapshot escrow) we need to define: encryption standard (AES-256), key-handback workflow, steward nomination, and a mutually agreed release certificate. Option B (witness-lite) needs a defined witness window (max 4 hours per quarter) and an acceptance test checklist.

Please see inline comments in the redline file. I also started a short evidence_matrix_v1.csv that maps artifacts to who holds them and the trigger conditions. We should aim to send a consolidated packet to ValleyHealth by EOD Fri 2027-09-03. If legal wants changes, please mark them in the doc and ping me — I'll shepherd ops changes.

On the sync: Thu 10:00 PT works for me; Connor you OK to host?

Karthik

--
Attachments: RH-privdeploy-addendum_redline_v1.docx (redline with inline comments)
             evidence_matrix_v1.csv (artifact -> trigger mapping)

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@valleyhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@valleyhealth.com, audit-team@thirdparty-audit.com
Date: Sat, 04 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment: addendum timing + evidence dependencies

Connor / Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for the detailed options. ValleyHealth prefers Option A (snapshot escrow) as our baseline; we also want Option B documented as an alternative if the escrow steward approach is delayed. A few clarifications from procurement/security before you finalize the packet: 

- Can Redwood confirm the steward nomination process (we prefer a neutral third-party escrow firm; we will provide a short list).
- For the operator access gating, the named contact will be our Infosec director, I will confirm the email by EOD 2027-09-06.
- For audit artifacts: the external auditor (audit-team@thirdparty-audit.com) needs confirmation that snapshots include a signed manifest and a hash chain that can be verified independently.

We will hold the Thurs 10:00 slot for the sync; please send the redline + evidence matrix at least 2 hours before so our legal & audit attendees can review.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the packet.

Best,
Alice

--
Attachments referenced: Valley_MSA_questions.pdf
